description: Get the status and, once terminal, the structured resolution of a call started with place_call. Returns instantly by default. Pass wait_seconds (max 50) to have the server hold the request and return early on any status change — fewer round trips while a call is in progress. Terminal statuses: completed, answered_silently, no_answer, busy, voicemail, failed, rejected, canceled, declined_recording, opted_out. rejected means safety screening declined the objective before dialing; error.message and resolution.summary explain why. Terminal calls include a `resolution` {outcome: achieved|partially_achieved|not_achieved|no_conversation|unknown, summary, commitments[], follow_ups[], key_facts[]} — read it before the transcript; it is the answer. unknown means the outcome could not be determined; review the transcript. Completed calls also carry the transcript (may be marked transcript_truncated) and a recording_url the user can listen to (private links expire after ~1 hour). The resolution can lag the terminal status by a few seconds while it is extracted. Calls include the resolved locale, language, voice, and is_public; public calls return token-free listen and recording URLs that remain accessible while public. Use set_call_visibility only when the user explicitly asks to publish or make private. Every call includes a listen_url — the call page for the user (live audio + transcript while in progress; recording + transcript once ended). ended_by='user' on a canceled call means the user deliberately stopped it from that page — don't retry. recording_status=processing means the LiveKit session recording is being finalized and copied to private storage separately from the result. A recording can fail or be unavailable. Call get_call again, or pass wait_seconds on an already-terminal call to wait for a recording state change.

wait_seconds.description: 0 (default) = instant status check. Up to 50 = server-side long-poll.

name: get_call

call_id.description: Call identifier used with get_call, end_call and set_call_visibility.

anyOf.description: Reserved usage units; absent on legacy calls.
ISO 8601 end time; null while active.

ended_by.description: Party or system that ended the call.

is_public.description: Whether the call has a public link.

listen_url.description: URL for the user to listen, read the transcript and stop an active call.

locale.description: Resolved BCP 47 language/locale for this call.

anyOf.description: Audio URL when ready; private URLs expire.

callee_requested_no_further_calls.description: Whether the recipient asked not to be called again.

follow_ups.description: Actions the user still needs to take.

outcome.description: Whether the call objective was met; unknown when review is unavailable or evidence is insufficient.

transcript.description: Conversation entries; empty before speech is available.

at_ms.description: Milliseconds from the transcript timeline origin.

transcript_truncated.description: Whether earlier transcript content was omitted.

outputSchema.description: Successful result or a machine-readable tool error.
